items.description: `_RELEASE_KEYS` gains `reconciler`, `deployed`, `autoSync`, `repo`, `targetRevision`: a release.yaml carrying all five passes the allowlist check, while any other key still fails loud with a non-zero exit.
items.rationale: Diff confirms the five keys added to `_RELEASE_KEYS` (release.py:12-25). `kc project test` rerun by the test phase: 53 passed. test_release.py::test_the_five_new_keys_pass_the_allowlist resolves a release.yaml carrying all five (plus reconciler: jenkins) and asserts it resolves; test_an_unknown_release_key_fails_loud and test_an_unknown_key_still_fails_loud_on_a_migrated_entry both assert a sixth, unrecognised key (`chrat`) still raises `unknown keys` — on a jenkins release and on a migrated one.

items.description: `discover_releases` skips non-`jenkins` reconcilers by direct file read — no `deploy config` subprocess per release and no chart-existence trip.
items.rationale: read_reconciler() opens release.yaml directly with no subprocess (resolve_helm_args.py:192-201); discover_releases skips on it at :210-213. tests/test_resolve_helm_args.py::test_the_reconciler_is_read_from_the_file_not_through_deploy_config monkeypatches subprocess.run to pytest.fail if called, and passes. Live-tree check (this pass): added a temporary `reconciler: argo-cd` release.yaml under configs/prd/calendar-support/prd (not committed) — discover_releases('.') dropped from 51 to 50 releases with calendar-support absent; file removed afterward, `git status --short` clean.
evidence: live-tree: discover_releases('.') over real configs/prd/ = 51 baseline / 50 with a temporary argo-cd entry, entry then removed

items.description: Helm-bearing verbs (`deploy`, `template`, `stop`, `uninstall`) refuse `argo-cd` releases with a clear message and a non-zero exit.
items.rationale: _JENKINS_ONLY_VERBS (main.py:50-52) includes all four; the guard raises before apply_cluster_environment (main.py:131-138). tests/test_main_verbs.py::test_a_refused_verb_names_the_release_and_its_reconciler is parametrized over every member of _JENKINS_ONLY_VERBS (including these four), asserts exit 1 and that stderr names the release (`prd/foo@prd`), the reconciler (`argo-cd`) and the verb. 53 passed.

items.description: The state-mutating Terraform verbs `apply`, `destroy` and `import` refuse an `argo-cd` release too, so nothing writes against the old, emptied HelmCharts Terraform state key (D32).
items.rationale: apply/destroy/import are members of _JENKINS_ONLY_VERBS (main.py:51); the same parametrized test (test_a_refused_verb_names_the_release_and_its_reconciler) covers all three, including import's two extra positional args via the ARGV map.

items.description: The genuinely read-only inspection verbs — `plan`, `output`, `config`, `wait` — stay usable against a migrated release; being able to look at one is worth keeping. `config` in particular never refuses, since `gen_architecture` calls it for every prd stage and does not catch a non-zero exit.
items.rationale: plan/output/config/wait are absent from _JENKINS_ONLY_VERBS (partition asserted by test_the_refused_and_inspection_verbs_partition_the_cli). test_config_reports_a_falsy_chart_rather_than_failing asserts `deploy config` on an argo-cd release exits 0 with chart_name: null — the exact call gen_architecture.py:578-580 makes. test_the_terraform_inspection_verbs_do_not_refuse[plan|output] and test_wait_does_not_refuse confirm the other three. Live-tree check (this pass): `deploy config prd/calendar-support` against a real temporary argo-cd entry exited 0 with chart_name: null (entry removed afterward).
evidence: live-tree: `deploy config prd/calendar-support` on a temporary real argo-cd entry → exit 0, chart_name: null

items.description: `reconciler:` defaults to `jenkins` when absent: both a missing key and a missing release.yaml resolve and enumerate as Jenkins-owned, and every release that exists today behaves exactly as it does now.
items.rationale: Both read sites default via `.get("reconciler", "jenkins")` (release.py:161; resolve_helm_args.py read_reconciler at :192-201, returning 'jenkins' for a missing file at :195-196 and via .get default for a missing key at :201). test_an_absent_file_and_an_absent_key_both_mean_jenkins covers resolve(); test_prd_tree.py's real-tree pass (51/51 discovered and resolved) is the enumeration-side proof, since none of today's release.yaml files name a reconciler. Live-tree baseline (this pass) confirms discover_releases('.') = 51 on unmodified main.

items.description: `chart: null` keeps HelmCharts release resolution working once `charts/<app>/` is deleted, using the existing infra-only value and no new mechanism.
items.rationale: The `chart:` handling at release.py:163-171 and chart_ref at :74-82 are unchanged by this slice's diff (confirmed by `git diff origin/main..HEAD`). test_chart_null_is_an_infra_only_release asserts chart_name/chart_path/chart_ref all resolve to None. configs/dev/_ci/prd/release.yaml is the pre-existing live user of this path and was not touched.

items.description: A registered `reconciler: argo-cd` entry does not break `gen-architecture`, whatever shape the entry takes — `chart:` omitted, `chart: null`, or an `upstream: {repo, chart, version}` block: the run completes and the migrated app drops out of the model, rather than failing `Jenkinsfile.architecture` and losing the whole artifact. Silent non-coverage is the accepted outcome; a failure is not.
items.rationale: gen_architecture.releases() (gen_architecture.py:200-210) is reconciler-blind and its only touch point with release semantics is the `deploy config` subprocess call at :578-580, three lines before the falsy-chart_name skip at :581; a non-zero exit there is what would take the build down (check_returncode at :149-158, uncaught in main()). test_an_entry_another_reconciler_owns_is_not_validated_as_a_release proves resolve() returns chart_name=None (never raising) for all three entry shapes design.md specifies (chart omitted, chart: null, upstream: block) — the exact record `deploy config` serialises. test_config_reports_a_falsy_chart_rather_than_failing proves the CLI wrapper itself exits 0. Live-tree (this pass): a real temporary argo-cd stage (configs/prd/calendar-support/prd, chart: null) made `deploy config prd/calendar-support` exit 0 with chart_name: null against the actual repo tree; entry removed afterward, git status clean. Not run: a full `gen-architecture` invocation, which needs the published cross-repo architecture dataset this pod does not have — the mechanism it depends on (a non-raising `deploy config`) is what's proven instead, matching what P2 recorded doing at landing time.
evidence: live-tree: `deploy config prd/calendar-support` on a temporary real argo-cd entry → exit 0, chart_name: null

items.description: A registered `reconciler: argo-cd` entry does not break `audit-prd-orphans` or `recommend-resources` — each still runs to completion over `configs/prd/`.
items.rationale: Neither walker calls resolve() or the deploy CLI, so neither can raise from anything this slice changed. audit_prd_orphans._release_yaml (audit_prd_orphans.py:65-70) is a bare `yaml.safe_load` with no key allowlist — an argo-cd entry's five extra keys are simply ignored; the code path already misclassifies a null-chart release as a non-orphan-candidate desired state, which is the pre-existing false-positive bug already recorded in close-out.md, not a crash. recommend_resources.get_stages() (recommend_resources.py:161-176) walks configs/prd/ directly and never reads release.yaml or calls resolve()/the CLI at all, so it is structurally unaffected by anything this slice touches. Confirmed by reading both modules; no code path in either reaches release.py or main.py. Live-tree (this pass): with the temporary real argo-cd entry present, `audit-prd-orphans desired` ran to completion (exit 0, printed its enumeration-commands banner, no traceback) — direct confirmation, not just code reading.
evidence: close-out.md — "audit-prd-orphans will report every migrated app's Helm release as an orphan candidate" (pre-existing, unaffected by this verification)
live-tree: `audit-prd-orphans desired` with a temporary argo-cd entry present → exit 0, no traceback

items.description: The Jenkins deploy pipeline's release list and `collect-versions` survive a registered entry: both produce their output without a traceback, and the migrated release simply gets no deploy stage.
items.rationale: Both call discover_releases(), which excludes a non-jenkins stage before either ever sees it (R2, resolve_helm_args.py:210-213) — collect_version_dependencies.py:18 calls it directly; the Jenkinsfile's release list (Jenkinsfile:55-57) goes through resolve_helm_args.main(), same function. Live-tree (this pass): discover_releases('.') with a temporary real argo-cd entry returned 50 releases, the migrated one absent, matching "gets no deploy stage." IaC/HelmCharts build #5820 (triggered by this pass's push) ran "Collect releases" successfully and every one of the 51 real "Deploying X@Y" stages was skipped (none of this slice's files match the Jenkinsfile's changed() path globs), confirming the pipeline survives end to end on the real tree. Live-tree (this pass): collect_version_dependencies.resolve_helm_args.discover_releases('.') with the temporary entry present returned 50 releases with calendar-support absent — the same skip collect-versions inherits, confirmed directly rather than only by citation.
evidence: live-tree: discover_releases('.') = 50/51 with a temporary argo-cd entry present
Jenkins IaC/HelmCharts build #5820 (2026-08-16, triggered by this pass's push of 3c9af98) — SUCCESS, Collect releases green, all 51 deploy stages skipped
live-tree: collect-versions' discover_releases('.') = 50/51 with a temporary argo-cd entry present, entry absent from the list

items.area: Ruling — how this slice is proven
items.description: pytest arrives as a Poetry dependency group in HelmCharts' own pyproject.toml and the container needs nothing new: a `poetry install --only main` — what the iac image and CI use — installs no test dependency, and the Jenkinsfile is unchanged.
items.rationale: Live check (this pass): fresh clone of the repo, `poetry install --only main --no-interaction` installed 7 runtime packages (certifi/charset-normalizer/idna/pyyaml/requests/semver/urllib3) plus the project itself, no pytest; `python -c "import pytest"` raised ModuleNotFoundError. Jenkinsfile's IAC_SETUP is unchanged by this slice's diff and its `uv pip install -e .` installs only the main dependency set — confirmed in IaC/HelmCharts build #5820's log ("Installed 8 packages", no pytest).
evidence: live check: `poetry install --only main` in a fresh clone → no pytest; `import pytest` → ModuleNotFoundError
Jenkins IaC/HelmCharts build #5820 log — IAC_SETUP install step lists 8 packages, no pytest

items.description: A release whose `chart:` overrides the config-directory name resolves through the local-chart path instead of falling through to the upstream-repo path and raising; the fix is provably inert for every current release, none of which sets a top-level `chart:`.
items.rationale: Diff confirms all three sites key on chart_name: the routing test at get_chart_args (resolve_helm_args.py:174) and both reads in get_helm_images (values.yaml at :38, templates/ walk at :49). tests/test_resolve_helm_args.py::test_a_chart_overriding_the_directory_name_resolves_locally, ::test_a_conventional_local_chart_still_resolves_locally, ::test_an_upstream_release_still_resolves_through_the_repo (all three routing cases, both paths stubbed) and ::test_the_images_come_from_the_resolved_chart_not_the_config_directory all pass. Inertness confirmed: `grep -rn 'chart:' configs/prd/` finds only configs/dev/_ci/prd/release.yaml's `chart: null`, which is falsy and short-circuits before this code path.

items.area: Ruling — how this slice is proven
items.description: The suite is hermetic: `kc project test` is green with no cluster, no network and no `helm`/`kubectl`/`terraform` subprocess, and leaves the repo's real `configs/` tree unmodified.
items.rationale: `cexec iac poetry run pytest -q` rerun by the test phase: 53 passed. `grep -rn subprocess tests/` finds exactly one reference — a monkeypatch in test_the_reconciler_is_read_from_the_file_not_through_deploy_config that fails the test if subprocess.run is reached, actively enforcing hermeticity rather than merely assuming it. `git status --short` in HelmCharts was clean before this pass's suite run, after it, and after this pass's own live-tree smoke checks (temporary file added and removed).
evidence: kc project test rerun by test phase: 53 passed
git status --short clean before/after the suite run and this pass's live-tree checks

items.description: `refresh-secrets` refuses an `argo-cd` release: it is not an inspection verb — it annotates the namespace's ExternalSecrets and then rolls their consumers, which in a migrated namespace are Argo-owned pod templates.
items.rationale: "refresh-secrets" is a member of _JENKINS_ONLY_VERBS (main.py:51). tests/test_main_verbs.py::test_a_refused_verb_names_the_release_and_its_reconciler is parametrized over the full frozenset, including refresh-secrets, and passes (exit 1, message names the release, reconciler and verb).

items.description: `_UPSTREAM_KEYS` is not widened and every `jenkins`-owned release keeps every check exactly as strict as today — the chart-existence check and the `upstream:` block's exactly-{repo_name, repo_url, chart} check both still fire for them; only an entry that names a non-`jenkins` reconciler is exempt.
items.rationale: `git diff origin/main..HEAD -- tools/deploy/deploy_cli/release.py` shows `_UPSTREAM_KEYS = {"repo_name", "repo_url", "chart"}` untouched by this slice. test_upstream_takes_exactly_its_three_keys (extra-key and missing-key cases) and test_a_jenkins_release_keeps_both_checks (chart-existence and upstream-keys cases) both pass against jenkins-reconciler releases, proving the two checks still fire unchanged. test_an_entry_another_reconciler_owns_is_not_validated_as_a_release proves the same two checks do not fire for a non-jenkins entry, including one carrying an `upstream: {repo, chart, version}` block that would fail the stricter allowlist if validated.
